She sits tall on the throne with her legs crossed at the knee, a slender black leather riding crop with a small flat leather tip resting across her knee in her right hand, her left hand resting on the stone armrest. #1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy red satin with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#1: Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

#2: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, demure and soft, low bun hair, real living eyes. #2: Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. #2: Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
#2: Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart. Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor at the foot of the throne, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#2: Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

Environment: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with a heavy carved stone throne with high stone arms and a high stone back set against a rough-cut stone block wall, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
